parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is a steel component that forms one of the two handles and jaws of the tool.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits the user's hand force to the gripping or cutting area of the pliers.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the base body to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers is the main structural part that includes one handle and one jaw, connected to the pivot.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the stationary or complementary half of the pliers, supporting the pivot and providing the opposing force for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary while the leg part moves relative to it around the pivot joint.
